native_evidence.limitation: The native relation proves mod-to-skill identity and zero shares; unique item identity/ownership comes from the frozen item text and Item:<id>:<name>, <base> metadata.

old_lookup_failure.description: Before e7ae8051, name-indexed base_items retained the last duplicate display name (the native unique gem), and skill_id_by_name returned that native effect. mark_item_granted_skills demanded exact effect equality, so exported ordinary Blink/Herald aliases did not match the native grant, remained ordinary gems, and contributed nominal 157. e7ae8051 joins proven attachments to the explicit native/alias pair and marks the one matching listing. 1da34acb preserves selected-effect ordinals; ef587706 preserves armour activation across sets; 45a3c00a adds active-skill-only fallback, which these XML gem-list groups do not require.

## Parity 体系（回归基准）

PoB2 对照是现有的回归基准（对照值不是真值，见上一节和“排查数值差异”），三层校验互补：

1. **`crates/pobr-build/tests/parity/ninja_parity.rs`** — 遍历 `examples/demo-bd-test/builds/*/`（真实 PoB2 build + `meta.json::player_stats` 黄金数值），零硬编码对比全部职业/技能；`parity_no_regression` 断言聚合命中率不低于基线。防御/属性与 DPS 分列报告，未完成的 offence 管线不会掩盖防御侧信号。基线只在一种情况下下降：PoB2 的对照值被游戏自己的数据证明有误、PoBR 有意与它不同（上一节“已知的有意差异”）；这时在基线常量旁写明是哪个构筑的哪一格、依据哪条规则，其余格子仍须全部命中。
2. **golden / dual-run 套件** — `crates/pobr-build/tests/parity/` 下的 golden 与 PoB2 对照用例，以及 `tests/dualrun/` 下的 statmap / config 对照，钉住中间值与配置语义。
3. **`tools/pob2-oracle`** — 需要逐分量定位偏差时，从 vendored PoB2 直接 dump Lua 侧计算分解对照。

- 物品授予的技能（例如 “Grants Skill: Level N Eternal Rage”）的属性需求只决定它降到哪一级（见“物品授予的技能”一段），不计入 `ReqStr` / `ReqDex` / `ReqInt`；构筑码另列的同等级普通组被认作同一技能，也不计入（`calc_orchestrator::requirements::requirement_snapshots`）。PoB2 按宝石计入，因此 Wolf Pack / Eternal Rage 抬高参考值的力量需求，Trinity 抬高敏捷需求，Blink / Cast on Critical 抬高智力需求；权杖的 Purity of Ice 和护身符的 Time of Need 也适用。

Unique item grants use the game's `ModGrantedSkills` attachment relationship,
not display-name collision order. The current catalog records Coming Calamity's
three `UniqueHeraldOf*Player` variants and Sands of Silk's `BlinkSandPlayer`.
Only proven attached calculation groups are canonicalized; imported identities
and independent gems remain intact. Zero base Spirit reservation does not exempt
additive support reservation. Armour grants retain their group's activation set,
and changing an effect list must preserve the selected effect's meaning.
